blocks.content: 5w-10=20\quad\xrightarrow{+10\text{ to both sides}}\quad5w=30\quad\xrightarrow{\div5\text{ on both sides}}\quad w=6
The same operation on both sides preserves equality.

result.reply: Correct. Adding 10 to both sides gives 5w = 30, then dividing both sides by 5 gives w = 6. Your reason is right too: equal operations preserve the equation because both sides change identically. Want to return to cell transport next?
